_comment: Portfolio analysis settings (packages/analysis/portfolio_risk.py). Statistics use WEEKLY returns of split-adjusted closes: on a thinly traded market daily returns of two shares are rarely synchronous, which understates their co-movement (PRODUCT_CONTEXT.md section 74). History applies today's quantities to past prices; it is not the owner's actual performance.
_participation_note: Days to sell a holding assume selling at most this share of the average daily volume, so the order does not become the market.
